title: FRANK Hybrid-Freshness Multi-Timescale Semantic Runtime
summary: The 2026-08-05 runtime architecture corrects the prior static-repository interpretation: FRANK's live GWT is workspace_broadcast.py persisted through consciousness.db and read by Core, while global_workspace.py is a process-local auxiliary/legacy bus. The next architecture candidate preserves FRANK's five logical timescales but collapses accidental process boundaries into a semantic runtime. GWT scheduling becomes hybrid: a spontaneous 60 s heartbeat plus semantic-dirty/query freshness refresh and immediate high-salience refresh. Needle becomes a fast pre-model capability proposal reflex behind an external authority gateway. Zahl→Wort→Gewicht remains a representation invariant across exact state, active workspace projection and slow LoRA disposition.
architecture_candidate: FAST_REFLEX_KERNEL: Amygdala + Thalamus + Nucleus Accumbens + Needle intent proposal, logically distinct but colocated where safe
WORKSPACE_KERNEL: channel candidates + salience competition + ignition + semantic focus + freshness validity envelope
REQUEST_KERNEL: Core context assembly + inference broker + model response
SLOW_PERSONALITY_LOOP: E-PQ/homeostasis with explicit event provenance
CONSOLIDATION_LOOP: memory consolidation + experience-vector recurrence + LoRA training/export
HARD_BOUNDARIES: external capability gateway, model execution resource boundary, durable/replay truth boundary
open_questions: What is the live distribution of workspace_age_ms and relevant channel changes at Core reads?
Does a pre-query refresh materially change focus, response quality, later state or goal behavior?
Which FRANK channel revisions form a sound dependency scope for workspace validity?
Can workspace_broadcast carry CC-RC1.1 episode/receipt identity without increasing LoRA-facing text?
Should experience-vector novelty modulate only scheduling/goal proposal or also goal revision, and under what capability/utility constraints?
Where is the live crossover between SQLite persistence, shared-memory active projection and rebuild/replay cost?
